import 'dart:io';

import 'package:hazard_fixture/place.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  test('starts in the package', () {
    expect(isPackage(here()), isTrue);
    expect(isPackage(Directory.systemTemp.path), isFalse);
  });

  // Leaves the process somewhere else, and does not go back.
  test('moves', () {
    final start = here();
    goTo(Directory.systemTemp.path);
    expect(here(), isNot(start));
  });
}
